title: AgriSeq Library Prep Part 1 - DNA Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: Pooling](./7855ef-part4) **Note about tips** The OT-2 will track tips from Part 1 to Part 4 of the protocol (e.g. tip leaves off in H11 at the end of protocol 1; first tip pick up will be from H12 in Part 2). steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required parameters (e.g., number of samples) into the OT‑2 software.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the 384‑well plate, tip racks, and any other required labware in the specified slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, calibrate the positions of the tip racks, pipette, and all labware as instructed; use calibration tips as described in support articles.

steps.title: Distribute amplification mix
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 will dispense 7 µL of Amplification Mix into each well of the 384‑well plate for the number of samples specified.

steps.title: Add DNA
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 will then add 3 µL of DNA to each well that already contains Amplification Mix.

steps.title: Manage tip racks
steps.instruction: Tip tracking continues from Part 1 to Part 4 (e.g., tip leaves at H11 at the end of Part 1; next pick‑up at H12). If the robot prompts that tips are exhausted, replace all tip racks before continuing.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑App to start the DNA transfer protocol.
